secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys. Optional — app boots without it but Stripe checkout returns 'not configured'.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret from https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks. Optional — needed for automatic subscription status updates.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys. Optional — for frontend Stripe.js.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (sk-...) from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys — needed for AI agent features. Optional in dev mode.
